title: 십 분 뒤에 와
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and Funk Pop. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated sixteenth-note muted scratches and staccato chords. A slap bass guitar performs a busy, percussive line with frequent slides and pops. The drum kit features a tight, dry snare and a consistent kick drum pattern. Bright, staccato brass stabs from a trumpet and saxophone section punctuate the transitions. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, melodic style with occasional breathy textures. Key of E Major. Tempo is 115 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean funk guitar scratches, slap bass enters]
[brass stabs]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
새벽 세 시 [staccato guitar chords]
전화를 걸어
목이 막혀서
말이 안 와 [bass slide]
숨소리만 가
넌 알아들어
골목 편의점 앞
불빛 아래서 있어 [brass section enters]
날씨가 차가워
코끝이 빨개져
울었나 봐
핸드폰만 봐
